title: RecipeTin's Sausage Gnocchi Soup
ingredients: Meat & Gnocchi: 500g Italian sausage, 500g potato gnocchi
Aromatics: 1.5 tbsp olive oil, 1 diced onion, 2 minced garlic cloves
Veggies & Spices: 2 diced celery sticks, 1 diced carrot, 0.75 tsp Italian herbs, 0.25 tsp chilli flakes
Liquid Base: 80ml dry white wine, 43g plain flour, 1L low sodium chicken stock
Seasoning & Dairy: 2.5g salt, 1.5g black pepper, 240ml heavy cream, 50g parmesan
Finishers: 45g baby spinach, crusty bread for serving
steps: Brown sausage in pot over high heat, remove with a slotted spoon and reserve.
Sauté onion and garlic on medium-high for 2 min, then add carrot, celery, herbs, and chilli for 2 min.
Pour in wine and simmer until mostly evaporated, then stir in flour to coat.
Add stock, salt, pepper, and cooked sausage, then simmer for 5 min.
Stir in cream and simmer for 5 min, then add gnocchi and parmesan and simmer for 2 min.
Stir in spinach until wilted, ladle into bowls, and serve with extra parmesan and bread.
